description: Brandon Wilke’s political engagement ignited during the height of COVID-19 restrictions when a local restaurant chose to keep its doors open despite lockdown mandates from St. Louis County’s county executive. Observing government officials relentlessly enforcing these restrictions on a business striving to serve its community, Wilke felt a profound frustration that became the catalyst for his journey into politics. "It made me upset," he recalls. His belief in personal freedoms and local control
